mechanism_narrative: A sustained decline in the federal funds rate (FEDFUNDS) signals an accommodative monetary policy that lowers discount rates for equity valuation, driving positive S&P 500 returns over the next 20 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS declines for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: A decline in the unemployment rate below 5.5% signals a tightening labor market that boosts consumer spending and corporate earnings, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when UNRATE falls below 5.5%.

mechanism_narrative: Simultaneous growth in housing starts (HOUST) and employment (PAYEMS) indicates robust consumer demand and income growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days through elevated corporate earnings.
failure_condition: The joint increase in HOUST and PAYEMS does not produce positive 20-day SPX returns in more than 60% of cases.

mechanism_narrative: In a regime of high industrial production (INDPRO > 110) and low unemployment (UNRATE < 5.5), the S&P 500 experiences positive returns over 60 days due to sustained corporate profit growth from strong manufacturing and labor conditions.
regime_hint: high industrial production and low unemployment
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO > 110 and UNRATE < 5.5.

mechanism_narrative: A federal funds rate above 3.0% signals a tightening monetary policy that increases discount rates and reduces equity valuations, leading to negative S&P 500 returns over 5 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 5-day returns are positive in more than 60% of periods when FEDFUNDS > 3.0.

mechanism_narrative: A sustained increase in employment (PAYEMS) indicates a strengthening labor market that supports consumer spending and corporate earnings, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when PAYEMS increases for 3 consecutive months.

mechanism_narrative: Housing starts exceeding 1,100 thousand units signal strong residential investment that boosts construction activity and consumer confidence, leading to positive S&P 500 returns over 20 days.
failure_condition: SPX 20-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when HOUST > 1100.

mechanism_narrative: A rising industrial production (INDPRO) indicates a strengthening manufacturing sector that supports corporate earnings growth, driving positive S&P 500 returns over 60 trading days.
failure_condition: SPX 60-day returns are negative in more than 60% of periods when INDPRO increases for 3 consecutive months.
